inputInjectionApi: None: external native keyboard events; actual legacy Input state is observed
inputFocusDiagnostics: Each sample records application focus, focused Editor window type and any-key booleans. No input text or key content other than the required F state is captured.
samplingPoint: An additional final Update subsystem callback, after ScriptRunBehaviourUpdate and before the later PostLateUpdate.InputEndFrame; no generated method is invoked by the harness.
limitations: One reviewed script and one authored keyboard/color mechanic, not general model reliability.

Input delivery must be independently observed. If batch Game View injection is unavailable, behavior is not evaluated; RunNative uses externally supplied real Game View key events and a separate receipt.
Both renderers begin with an independent sentinel. The candidate must initialize blue while the untouched control remains sentinel.
Renderer material/property-block colors are measured; this is not a rendered image or a GPU/shader/art-quality test.
